from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageOps
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.array(im).astype(float)
# local contrast normalization via large blur
blur=np.array(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(60))).astype(float)
diff=a-blur
d=diff/ (np.abs(diff).max()) *127 +128
d=np.clip(d,0,255).astype('uint8')
Image.fromarray(d).save('local.png')
print('ok')
"", "description": "Local contrast normalization"}
